# SmartAss Facts

> SmartAss Facts is a fact-or-fake trivia library: 5,600+ surprising claims across 34 categories, each labeled TRUE or FAKE with a short explanation, plus 51 deep-dive myth debunks and 50 "X vs Y" comparison explainers. Editor: Gigi Smarts.

Every fact page states its verdict (true or fake) in the page text and in structured data. Myth and comparison pages include FAQs and cited primary sources (USGS, NOAA, Britannica and similar).

## Main sections

- [All facts by category](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/): browse every category
- [Myths debunked](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/myths/): 51 popular myths, each with a verdict, explanation, sources and FAQ
- [vs comparisons](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/vs/): 50 commonly confused pairs explained (e.g. accuracy vs precision, lava vs magma)
- [Countries](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/countries/), [Famous people](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/people/), [Animals](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/animals/), [Topics](https://smartassfacts.com/facts/topics/): curated hub pages
- [Random fact generator](https://smartassfacts.com/random/): one random labeled fact at a time
- [The game](https://smartassfacts.com/): play Fake or Fact
- [Embeddable quiz widget for educators](https://smartassfacts.com/embed/quiz/)
- [Sitemap](https://smartassfacts.com/sitemap.xml)
